value.authenticity_rationale: The pre-image is a declaration-only forward-run-with-shape compiler-state carrier over the shipped source, compiled to this same translation unit at retail's frame and length. Retail's body is that compile with the operand order of fourteen equality compares exchanged in place: at thirteen sites our state emits the memory-first form `cmp [m],reg` (39 /r, the memory operand a relocated absolute address) where retail emits the register-first form `cmp reg,[m]` (3B /r), and at one esp-relative site the directions are reversed. Each mirror is the one-byte opcode flip with the ModRM and displacement kept, so no relocation moves; the branch after every compare is an equality test (thirteen je, one jne), which is its own mirror because ZF is symmetric under operand exchange; and the flags the exchange does change are proved dead at both successors of every site -- and re-proved on the rewritten image -- by the per-flag liveness fixpoint, so all fourteen exchanges are unobservable to the body's own control flow.

The donor renders the immediately preceding source state of the headers the campaign landing edited plus one framework carrier op; the three relational operand-order re-encodings are proved on the donor body, and the image is refused unless it equals retail under the relocation mask.
